description: Given only proctor's own onboarding surface (the proctor-suite skill, the docs and the CLI, at a pinned revision), can a shipped coding agent stage a working chat-only suite for a small chatbot project it has never seen? Each written suite is graded by running it against planted runs of its own tasks on nb's Mock provider: it must pass the right answers and fail the wrong ones.

arms.description: Qwen Code on the local model: the free shakedown arm

surface-present.description: the image held proctor and nb at the pinned revisions, runnable, nb answering on its Mock provider, and the proctor-suite skill where the agent looks for skills

validates.description: the agent wrote one suite, and proctor's list loads it without a problem

accepts-correct.description: the written suite passes every planted run that gives the right reply

rejects-wrong.description: the written suite fails every planted run that gives a wrong reply, by a check and not by breaking

chat-only.description: every arm of the written suite is bare nb and its program has no tools, so the bot only reads and answers

no-secrets.description: no file the agent wrote holds a key or secret value; config names keys as ${VAR} only

describes-everything.description: the written suite, each of its arms and each of its tasks carry a description for the report's reader
